judgments.rationale: The link "clique aqui." is the second item of the list under the h2 "Atendimento da Ouvidoria do MPMG"; its list item reads "Consulta ao andamento da manifestação: clique aqui." (the snapshot gives the listitem that name, and the packet's ancestors show it). The link text alone is vague, but its enclosing list item, which is programmatically determined link context (technique H77), says it opens the lookup of a complaint's progress, and the href (aplicacao.mpmg.mp.br/ouvidoria/service/cidadao/consulta) is that service; the preceding heading adds the Ouvidoria. So the claim that nothing around it tells where it goes is false of the capture, and the link meets 2.4.4. No other link shares its name and context (the first item's "clique aqui" sits in a different list item). The live page, fetched today, has the same markup and the screenshot shows the styled page, so the capture does not differ. The model had the list item text in its context and judged wrongly.

judgments.rationale: The page is the Ouvidoria (ombudsman) page of the MPMG portal: its h1 is "Ouvidoria", the breadcrumb is Home > Conheça o MPMG > Ouvidoria, and the content describes the ombudsman's channels. The title "Ouvidoria | Portal" names exactly that topic, which is what 2.4.2 and G88 ask (a title that describes the topic or purpose). The generic "Portal" suffix not naming the MPMG is at most an advisory point (G127), not a failure. So the claim that the title says nothing about the page is false, and the page meets 2.4.2. The live page returns the same <title> today, so the capture does not differ.
